newsitem.title: USA: Torricelli wins hot New Jersey Senate race.
newsitem.headline: Torricelli wins hot New Jersey Senate race.

text.p: Democratic Rep. Robert Torricelli defeated Republican Rep. Dick Zimmer for New Jersey's Senate seat after one of the dirtiest political battles of this campaign, television networks projected Tuesday.

Torricelli will replace popular Democratic Sen. Bill Bradley who surprised the party with his decision to retire. While both Zimmer and Torricelli were fairly moderate, neither held the loyalty of voters enjoyed by Bradley. Holding this Democratic seat was essential if the party was to have any chance of regaining control of the Senate this year.
